problem: The canonical static i18n builder, cache validator and fail-closed learning remained on main while the versioned English cache artifact itself was removed by later repository churn.
root_cause: Generated-but-authoritative website artifacts were not protected by a same-lineage existence/coverage invariant strongly enough to prevent later merges from deleting the cache while leaving dependent code and tests behind.
evidence: The proven cache blob from merged PR #2944 was restored unchanged in content, then compacted from 1,049,339 bytes to 1,018,510 bytes with 7,707 entries preserved so delivery admission can process the diff.
prevention: Treat .cache/bg-static-i18n-en.json as an authoritative generated website artifact whenever the canonical builder references it.
Any deletion or replacement of the cache must update the validator, learning and delivery documentation in the same lineage.
Keep the serialized cache compact enough for delivery control-plane diff processing; whitespace changes must not alter key/value content.
Before merge, require --validate-cache coverage against the current public source corpus.
